verdict: Leads are coming in, but cost per lead is rising and setup work is overdue.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 98 leads at $18.55 each — a functional baseline, but one that is under pressure: cost per lead rose 13% week-over-week while the number of leads dipped 6.9%, meaning the paid campaigns are working harder for slightly less. The sharper issue is that 10 planned build-out milestones — covering landing pages, local listing optimization, search campaigns, and CRM automation — remain undelivered, some dating back to July; until those are in place, the program is running on a partial foundation. Your Google Business Profile activity fell 48% week-over-week, and the Weston location is generating almost no calls from the impressions it receives, so that listing is being reviewed and corrected now. Next period, expect the local listing work and tracking repairs to reduce cost per lead pressure and restore visibility at underperforming locations.
